description: Orders food for delivery in one call: prices the order, quotes the delivery fee, then places it or returns a draft depending on the permission chosen when connecting (get_connection_permissions shows it). With full control it places the order within the spending limits set; with confirm-each-decision it places nothing and returns a draft summary with a draftId that confirm_delivery_order places. Same inputs and rules as draft_delivery_order. idempotencyKey is required: the same key returns the same order instead of creating a second one. When payment is online, the result includes a payment link to WaitApp's payment page where the guest sees the exact charge and pays it; this tool charges nothing. The venue must accept the order after it is placed; track_order follows it by orderCode.

deliveryAddress.description: Full delivery address. Not needed when savedLocationId is given

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value you generate for this order; reuse it on any retry

savedLocationId.description: The id of one of the person's saved locations (see list_saved_locations), used instead of deliveryAddress

name: place_delivery_order
title: Place a delivery order
